config.label: Nominatim API base URL
config.description: Nominatim API base URL. Override to use a private or mirror instance.

config.label: User-Agent sent to Nominatim and Overpass
config.description: User-Agent sent to Nominatim and Overpass. Required by usage policy.

config.label: Overpass API endpoint URL
config.description: Overpass API endpoint URL. When set, pins every query to this one endpoint and disables mirror failover. Leave unset to use OSM_OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS.

config.label: Comma-separated ordered list of Overpass endpoints
config.description: Comma-separated ordered list of Overpass endpoints. A transient failure advances to the next entry within the same tool call; a single entry means no failover. Verify a mirror's usage policy, data coverage, and freshness before adding it. Ignored when OSM_OVERPASS_BASE_URL is set.

config.label: Maximum Overpass queries submitted at once
config.description: Maximum Overpass queries submitted at once. Match the slot budget the endpoint advertises at /api/status.

config.label: Sets the minimum log level for output (e
config.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
